sections.text:
Ability Power 210. Damages all enemies with physical wind damage. Ability Power 290. Damages 1 random enemy additionally with physical wind damage.
Added effect: Increases critical hit damage for all allies by 40% for 60 seconds, and increases critical hit chance of all Lancer-Class allies by 30% for 60 seconds. 
Level bonus: Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
